Editorial notes

Structured fields cannot capture everything that matters when choosing between these. Notes below are explicitly editorial — human judgement, not metadata:

  • GUI versus code. A graphical flowsheeter and a Python framework solve the same equations and suit completely different workflows. Neither is more “advanced”.
  • Convergence behaviour on recycle-heavy flowsheets varies widely and is not captured by any field here. Try your own hardest case before committing.
  • Community size determines how fast you get unstuck, and is often the deciding factor for a student on a deadline.

To compare a different set, edit COMPARE_SETS in scripts/generate_resource_pages.py. An interactive picker is Phase 1 work.
